# Skip chown on mounted volumes, only run on /app
echo "Starting Mydia (skipping chown on mounted volumes)..."
mkdir -p /config /data /media 2>/dev/null || true
chown -R 1000:1000 /app 2>/dev/null || true
if [ -n "$TZ" ] && [ -f "/usr/share/zoneinfo/$TZ" ]; then
  ln -sf "/usr/share/zoneinfo/$TZ" /etc/localtime
fi
exec /app/bin/mydia start

cd /app
pip install --no-cache-dir --target /tmp/packages -r requirements.txt
export PYTHONPATH="/tmp/packages:$PYTHONPATH"
python app.py

set -e
JQ_VERSION=jq-1.7.1
curl -sSfL --retry 3 \
  "https://github.com/jqlang/jq/releases/download/$${JQ_VERSION}/jq-linux-amd64" \
  -o /tmp/jq
chmod +x /tmp/jq
export PATH="/tmp:$${PATH}"
exec /scripts/run.sh

echo "Seeding missing config files from image defaults (no-clobber)"
cp -rn /app/Configs/. /pvc-configs/
echo "Enforcing git-managed Difficulty.eco"
cp /git-configs/Difficulty.eco /pvc-configs/Difficulty.eco

#!/bin/sh
# Health-check the SLZB-06 Zigbee coordinator; if it is fully
# unresponsive (ESP32 lockup — HTTP port down), power-cycle its
# UniFi PoE port to force a hard reboot. A soft HTTP reboot cannot
# recover a full lockup, only a power cut can.
set -eu

n=0
while [ "$n" -lt "${CHECKS}" ]; do
  n=$((n + 1))
  if curl -sf -m 5 -o /dev/null "${COORD_URL}"; then
    echo "$(date -u +%FT%TZ) coordinator reachable on attempt ${n}/${CHECKS} — OK"
    exit 0
  fi
  echo "$(date -u +%FT%TZ) coordinator unreachable (${n}/${CHECKS})"
  [ "$n" -lt "${CHECKS}" ] && sleep "${INTERVAL}"
done

echo "$(date -u +%FT%TZ) coordinator down after ${CHECKS} checks — power-cycling PoE port ${PORT_IDX}"
code=$(curl -sk -m 20 -o /tmp/resp.json -w '%{http_code}' -X POST \
  -H "X-API-KEY: ${UNIFI_API_KEY}" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"action":"POWER_CYCLE"}' \
  "${UNIFI_HOST}/proxy/network/integration/v1/sites/${SITE_ID}/devices/${DEVICE_ID}/interfaces/ports/${PORT_IDX}/actions")
echo "power-cycle response HTTP ${code}: $(cat /tmp/resp.json 2>/dev/null || true)"
case "${code}" in
  2*) echo "power-cycle issued successfully"; exit 0 ;;
  *) echo "power-cycle FAILED"; exit 1 ;;
esac
